title: QUALITY MANAGER
description:
**QUALITY MANAGER****Role Purpose**
The Qualified Person (QP) is responsible for ensuring that medicinal products are manufactured, tested, certified, and released in full compliance with applicable GMP regulations and regulatory requirements. The role acts as a key quality representative within the site, fostering a strong quality culture while balancing compliance and operational needs.**Key Responsibilities*** Perform batch certification and release in accordance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations.
* Ensure ongoing GMP compliance across manufacturing and quality operations.
* Review and manage deviations, non\-conformances, CAPAs, and customer complaints.
* Support and participate in internal, external, and supplier audits.
* Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Manufacturing, and Site Leadership teams.
* Lead interactions with regulatory authorities during inspections, including AIFA and other health authorities.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives related to quality systems and regulatory compliance.
* Provide guidance and influence decision\-making to ensure an appropriate balance between operational requirements and compliance obligations.

**Required Qualifications*** Valid **AIFA Qualified Person Eligibility Certificate**.
* Degree in **Pharmacy, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology (CTF),** or a related scientific discipline.
* Registration with the **Order of Chemists** or **Pharmaceutical Chemists and Technologists** (may be completed after joining the company).

**Required Experience*** **7\-10 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry**.
* Experience working in **GMP\-regulated manufacturing sites**.
* Strong background in **Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, or Compliance** functions.
* Proven experience managing supplier audits, deviations, non\-conformances, CAPAs, and complaints.
* Experience within **API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient)** environments is considered highly relevant and valuable.

**Key Competencies*** Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships across Quality, Manufacturing, and Leadership teams.
* Excellent negotiation, mediation, and influencing capabilities.
* Pragmatic approach with strong compliance awareness.
* Flexibility, empathy, and sound judgment in complex situations.
* Confidence in managing regulatory inspections and establishing constructive relationships with inspectors.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken, enabling effective communication with European colleagues and international inspectors.

**Ideal Candidate Profile*** Professional with approximately **2\-3 years of experience as a Deputy Qualified Person** and the potential to grow into a fully autonomous QP role.
* Willing to relocate to the Verona area; daily commuting from distant locations is not considered sustainable.
* Able to work effectively with senior stakeholders and plant leadership, balancing business objectives with regulatory requirements.
* Collaborative, resilient, and capable of operating in a dynamic manufacturing environment while maintaining the highest quality standards.

**About Ecolab:**


At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent\-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science\-based solutions, data\-driven insights and world\-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.

*Ecolab’s commitment to diversity,**equity**and inclusion (DE\&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right.*


Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history.

**Join Ecolab and help us protect****what’s****vital.**


\#li\-eu

 **Compensation Range:**


The annual pay range for this position is 59\.500,00 \- 74\.400,00 \- 89\.200,00 EUR. This position is eligible for annual bonus. **Benefits:**


Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families.

 **Collective Agreement Information (Italy):**

In Italy, Ecolab applies the National Collective Labour Agreement for the Chemical Industry (CCNL Industria Chimica).

 **Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**  

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: RESPONSABILE CONTROLLO QUALITÁ e SISTEMA QUALITÁ
Reliability Maintenance Engineer
description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------

The Reliability Maintenance Engineer will join the Global Facilities \& Engineering team at our strategic production site in Noventa Padovana (PD), reporting to the Process Engineering Manager. In this role, the candidate will improve equipment reliability, optimize preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, and support the long\-term performance of process equipment, utilities and instrumentation. The role will work closely with Maintenance, Production, Quality, HSE and global engineering stakeholders to reduce failures, improve asset availability and support compliant manufacturing operations.  



**Tasks \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Analyze equipment performance, failure history and maintenance data to identify reliability improvement opportunities and recurring issues.
* Develop, optimize and periodically review preventive, predictive and condition\-based maintenance strategies for process equipment, utilities and instrumentation.
* Lead or support root cause analysis, FMEA, RCM and bad actor analysis, defining corrective and preventive actions to prevent failure recurrence.
* Monitor and report reliability indicators such as equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, maintenance backlog and preventive maintenance effectiveness.
* Support quality processes, including deviations, CAPA management and technical investigations related to maintenance and equipment reliability.
* Ensure accurate and effective use of the CMMS, contributing to asset master data management, maintenance plans, task lists, spare parts strategy and technical documentation.
* Support spare parts warehouse management, including critical spare parts identification, stock level optimization, obsolescence management and coordination with maintenance and procurement teams.
Collaborate with maintenance supervisors, technicians, production teams, quality functions and project engineering to improve equipment lifecycle performance and total cost of ownership.  
* 

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Approximately two years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or manufacturing engineering within a regulated industrial environment.
* Good knowledge of maintenance and reliability methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, RCM, preventive maintenance optimization and condition\-based monitoring.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and ability to analyze maintenance data and reliability indicators.
* Fluency in Italian and Good knowledge of English, at least B2 level.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience with biopharma or pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
* Familiar with GxP regulatory requirements, deviation management, CAPA processes and equipment lifecycle documentation and SAP CMMS
* Knowledge of Lean methodologies, TPM implementation
* Experience with predictive maintenance technologies such as vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis or ultrasonic inspection.
Familiarity with GoTrack or similar quality management systems.  
* 

**What we offer**
-----------------

* For this position we offer a 2\-years temporary contract.
* The gross annual base salary foreseen for this position ranges from €37\.000 to €43\.000, depending on candidate's skills and experience.
* Free access to the company canteen.
* A range of benefits for physical, financial, social and mental wellbeing.
A support to develop professional and personal paths including our full range of development programs.  
* 

We warmly welcome applications from candidates belonging to protected categories, in accordance with Law 68/99\.


We foster a workplace built on respect, trust, and empathy—free from discrimination. We are powered by our people, and we believe that our differences are our strengths. Everyone is valued, respected and empowered to be themselves.

title: Manager, EHS
description:
**Date:** Sep 11, 2026
  
**Req ID:** 104654
  
  

**Location:**  

Breganze, IT
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }

**Note:** Please submit your application/CV in English.
  
  

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
  
  

The EHS Manager is responsible for leading the Environmental, Health \& Safety function at the Breganze site, ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and AGCO standards while promoting a strong safety culture across the organization.
  
  

Acting as the site's designated RSPP, the role provides leadership, technical expertise and guidance on all Environmental, Health \& Safety matters. The EHS Manager leads a team of EHS professionals and works closely with leaders, managers and employees to strengthen safety performance, develop organizational capabilities, drive environmental compliance and support continuous improvement initiatives across the site.
  
  

**Your Impact:**  

**EHS Leadership:** Lead, coach and develop the site EHS team. Define priorities and objectives for the EHS to function in alignment with business needs and corporate requirements. Promote a culture of safety ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization. Act as the primary EHS advisor and subject matter expert for site leadership and functional managers. Drive employee engagement and participation in EHS initiatives.
  
**Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management:** Serve as the site's designated Repressure compliance with all applicable environmental, health and safety regulations and AGCO standards. Develop, implement and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and management systems. Lead risk assessments and hazard identification activities, ensuring effective mitigation plans are implemented. Coordinate internal and external audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews. Lead incident investigations and ensure effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  
**Training and Safety Culture:** Develop, coordinate and deliver Environmental, Health \& Safety training programs. Ensure compliance with mandatory training requirements and regulatory obligations. Coach leaders, supervisors and employees on EHS expectations, responsibilities and best practices. Lead awareness campaigns and initiatives aimed at strengthening the site's safety culture. Support the development of EHS competencies throughout the organization
  
**Environmental \& Sustainability:** Ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulatory requirements. Monitor environmental performance and drive improvement initiatives. Support sustainability programs and environmental impact reduction initiatives. Coordinate environmental reporting and related compliance activities.
  
**Continuous Improvement:** Analyze EHS performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement. Support operational, engineering, and facility projects from an EHS perspective. Drive implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Promote best practices and continuous improvement methodologies within the EHS function.
  
  

**Your Experience and Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's degree in engineering, Environmental Sciences, Occupational Health \& Safety or related field. Qualification to act as RSPP within an industrial environment.
  
Minimum 10 years of Environmental, Health \& Safety experience in manufacturing.
  
Previous people management experience. Strong knowledge of Italian health, safety and environmental legislation.
  
Experience with EHS management systems and ISO 45001\. Experience in risk assessment, incident investigation, and regulatory compliance.
  
Fluent Italian and English
  
  

**Your Benefits:**  

Attractive, fair remuneration including participation in our bonus scheme
  
Balance of work, family and free time due to flexible working time
  
Private health insurance with partial coverage of medical expenses
  
Canteen with meal allowance
  
  

**Your Workplace:**  

You will work in 5 days Onsite from our Breganze site.
  
  

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

**Applicable salary range:** €46,000 – €70,000 gross annual salary
  
  

The compensation range specified in this job posting represents an indicative range for the role. Final remuneration will be defined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, in compliance with applicable EU pay transparency and pay equity regulations.

title: Local Italy Program Leader (Summer 2027)
description:
**Local Italy Program Leader (Summer 2027\)**


Rustic Pathways is a student travel organization that offers the world's finest experiential education, community service, foreign language, and adventure programs. Our destinations stretch from the white\-sand beaches of Fiji to the rainforest canopies of Costa Rica, the high Atlas mountains to the Great Barrier Reef, and many places in between. We provide superior quality travel and service in some of the most welcoming countries for students around the world. Rustic Pathways demands professionalism and integrity across all of our operations, insists on quality in all aspects of our programs, and places a strong emphasis on the protection, safety, and well\-being of our students and staff. We empower students through innovative and responsible travel experiences to positively impact lives and communities around the world.

**Local Italy Program Leader** at Rustic Pathways

**The Position**


As a Local Program Leader, you live in the country of operation, Italy. Your primary responsibility is the care and well\-being of our students while they travel. You are a primary responder in all escalated situations, incidents, and emergencies. In partnership with your co\-leaders, you’ll collaborate to create a safe and successful program experience for all Rustic Pathways students. You’ll work directly with international leaders, community partners, activity operators, and Rustic Pathways managers. You are a liaison between the program experience and all stakeholders, providing trip updates and managing communication with parents and the global Rustic Pathways team. Expect to spend long days in some of the most welcoming communities on the planet. Community service professionals, customer service experts, globally conscious travelers, logistics lovers, and youth development facilitators are encouraged to apply. Rustic Pathways is committed to increasing diversity in our staff and recognizes the benefit of having a diverse, inclusive work environment. We actively encourage those from equity\-seeking groups to apply. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences represented by our leaders.


Must be safety\-oriented, with a passion for experiential education. The position requires a lot of physical and emotional stamina.


This is a seasonal position.

**Responsibilities**

* Embody Rustic Pathways’ mission, vision, and values
* Act as a role model and mentor to students
* Protect the safety of students and children by abiding by our zero\-tolerance policy for inappropriate behavior
* Monitor and manage student well\-being
* Follow Rustic Pathways’ protocols while on the program
* Address any student health issues and communicate action plans with parents
* Respond calmly to issues as they arise with a focus on customer service and safety
* Demonstrate responsible leadership and judgment, including cultural sensitivity
* Create positive and inclusive group dynamics
* Ensure students understand the history, culture, and context of the places visited
* Model responsible travel by adhering to Rustic Pathways' sustainability protocols
* Facilitate discussions drawing from your own personal experience and Rustic Pathways' discussion guides
* Serve as the primary communicator with local vendors–including restaurants, transportation providers, and activity partners–using the local language as needed
* Coordinate daily logistics with drivers, guides, and other service providers to ensure smooth program operations
* Support translation and cultural mediation between students, staff, and local partners to enhance cross\-cultural understanding and ensure clear communication

**Job Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
	+ At least 2 years of relevant experience in service\-learning, tourism, outdoor leadership, youth mentorship, customer service, or experiential education.
	+ At least 2 years of experience working with young adults and/or adolescents
	+ At least 6 months of experience living and/or working in an international, multicultural, or cross\-cultural environment
* **Education:**
	+ Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university OR equivalent work experience
* **Requirements:**
	+ Must be 22 years of age or older before your start date
	+ Demonstrated maturity and leadership skills
	+ Fluency in English and Italian
	+ Basic CPR and First Aid certification from a licensed provider
		- *NOTE: Certifications must ONLY be obtained through classroom or a blended online \+ classroom training.* ***Online\-only certifications are not acceptable.*** *Certificates must be submitted to Rustic Pathways at least three weeks prior to the start of Program Leader training*
* **Working knowledge in the following areas and/or roles:**
	+ Adventure Guiding, Outdoor Education, or Wilderness Therapy
	+ Teaching and/or instruction, specifically middle school or high school, in a multicultural environment
	+ Teaching (any subject) to non\-native English speakers
	+ Leadership Instruction
	+ Customer Service
	+ Volunteering with AmeriCorps, Peace Corps, and/or national service, or comparable positions
	+ Sociology or Anthropology
	+ Social Justice, Immigration, or Migration
	+ Marine Biology, Environmental Studies, Conservation, or Wildlife Biology
	+ Public Health, Global Health, or Water sanitation and hygiene program
	+ Mountaineering or Technical Climbing
	+ Community Service Coordinator
	+ Surf Instructor
	+ Soccer Coach
	+ Camp Counselor
* **Preferred Certifications (including but not limited to):**
	+ Wilderness First Responder
	+ Wilderness EMT
	+ Ocean Lifeguard
	+ Teaching Certifications (ex. TEFL/TESL)
* **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**
	+ Appreciation for diversity in cultures and experiences
	+ Excellent verbal and non\-verbal communication skills
	+ Patient, enthusiastic, analytical, flexible, and solution\-oriented
	+ Passion for discussion\-based learning and helping students make meaning of their experiences
	+ Understands the value of experiential education and travel for high school students
	+ Understands the value of parental communication for high school travel
	+ Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork
	+ Able to maintain excellence under pressure and ever\-changing conditions

**Location:**


Ability to work in Italy for at least 1\-8 consecutive weeks at a time (start date determined by mandatory in\-person training dates, which vary).

**Compensation:**


The weekly rate for this position is between $400 to $500 per week (weekly rate is determined by the number of years of Rustic Pathways program leader experience).

**A Note About Equal Employment Opportunity Questions:**


Though you are not required to answer them, we do encourage applicants to answer the Equal Employment Opportunity questions on our application. We cannot see your answers as we review your application. We only see the data as a full set, not connected to any identifying data on your application. In order to most effectively work to increase diversity, equity, and inclusion at Rustic Pathways, we need the data to know where we stand. Numbers are powerful. Please help us to improve as an organization by answering these questions if you are comfortable doing so.

**Equal Opportunity:**


Rustic Pathways is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**At\-Will Notice:**


Each employee of Rustic Pathways is employed “at will,” which means either the Company or the employee may terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any or no reason, with or without advanced notice. No individual or representative of Rustic Pathways can change this at\-will relationship absent a specific, written contract signed by the Company’s Chief Executive Officer or designee.

title: Junior Technical Specialist (Facility & Progettazione) – Architetto / Ingegnere / Geometra
description:
Per la nostra azienda **EstPro**, realtà consolidata con sede a Padova che offre servizi di consulenza energetica ed ingegneria in ambito aziendale, stiamo selezionando un/una **Junior Technical Specialist**.

Il team di EstPro è composto da professionisti con un forte background tecnico, che lavorano in un ambiente dinamico e coeso, con un focus preciso sull'efficienza energetica, la sostenibilità e l'innovazione degli immobili d'impresa.

**Il Ruolo:** La figura inserita avrà un ruolo ibrido e trasversale all’interno dell’ufficio tecnico, seguendo attività sia di facility che di progettazione. È l'opportunità ideale per un profilo tecnico junior che non vuole limitarsi al solo lavoro di scrivania, ma desidera seguire gli immobili d'impresa a 360 gradi: dal rilievo in campo, fino alla progettazione e gestione dell’immobile.

**Principali Responsabilità:**

* **Valutazione Tecnica degli immobili (Facility e Project):** analisi preliminare dello stato di fatto degli immobili. Sopralluoghi mirati all'identificazione e documentazione dei principali componenti, considerando anche le dotazioni impiantistiche (quadri elettrici, HVAC, illuminazione). Esecuzione di rilievi metrici integrati (tramite laser e strumentazione tradizionale). Validazione critica dei dati raccolti in campo, confronto con la documentazione fotografica, risoluzione di discrepanze e mappatura degli aspetti costruttivi e impiantistici.
* **Gestione manutenzioni ordinarie e straordinarie (Facility):** presa in carico delle segnalazioni (tramite sistema di ticketing) e classificazione delle priorità. Pianificazione degli interventi di manutenzione preventiva e gestione tempestiva di quella correttiva/guasti. Individuazione, qualifica e attivazione dei fornitori terzi: richiesta e confronto tecnico\-economico dei preventivi, coordinamento delle squadre esterne (manutentori, impiantisti) e verifica in campo della corretta esecuzione dei lavori. Supporto nell'aggiornamento della reportistica e nella raccolta della documentazione di base (es. certificazioni di impianto, DURC, verbali di intervento).
* **Verifica Urbanistica e Legittimità:** analisi documentale preliminare per la verifica della conformità urbanistica. Gestione delle richieste di accesso agli atti presso la P.A. e supporto nella redazione delle principali pratiche edilizie (CILA, SCIA, Permesso di Costruire).
* **Progettazione e supporto alla Direzione Lavori:** sviluppo della progettazione architettonica (dalla fase preliminare all'esecutiva). Redazione di computi metrici estimativi. Gestione dei sopralluoghi iniziali, interfaccia operativa con le ditte esecutrici e gestione dei rapporti tecnici.

**Requisiti Tecnici e Competenze:**

* **Formazione:** Laurea in Ingegneria (Edile/Civile), Architettura, oppure Diploma di Geometra, con esperienza almeno di 3 anni.
* **Software Gestionali/Office:** Ottima padronanza del Pacchetto Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), conoscenza di software per la redazione di computi metrici (es. Primus o similari).
* **Software Modellazione:** *Indispensabile* padronanza di AutoCAD 2D. Considerata un plus la capacità di modellazione 3D/renderizzazione e conoscenza di Revit/BIM (es. SketchUp \+ V\-Ray/Edificius/Revit).
* **Strumenti di IA Generativa:** Familiarità e attitudine all'uso di strumenti AI (es. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) per l'ottimizzazione del lavoro quotidiano: stesura rapida di relazioni tecniche, sintesi documentale, reportistica e automazione di task ripetitivi.
* **Nice to have:** Aver già affrontato in ambito accademico o in precedenti esperienze (anche brevi) tematiche legate alla riqualificazione energetica e al recupero del patrimonio edilizio esistente.

**Requisiti Personali:** 

* **Problem Solving:** Forte attitudine alla risoluzione rapida dei problemi, unita alla flessibilità necessaria per passare con naturalezza dalla precisione del lavoro al PC alla gestione pratica delle criticità durante i sopralluoghi.
* **Capacità Relazionali e Comunicative:** Spiccate doti interpersonali per interfacciarsi quotidianamente in modo chiaro, efficace e professionale con una pluralità di interlocutori, in particolare fornitori, ditte esecutrici e clienti aziendali.
* **Organizzazione e Pianificazione:** Elevate capacità organizzative per programmare in autonomia il proprio carico di lavoro quotidiano e pianificare con precisione le scadenze, i calendari dei sopralluoghi e la logistica degli interventi esterni.

**Cosa offre EstPro:**

* **Solidità e Reputazione:** Inserimento in un Gruppo con vent’anni di esperienza nella valorizzazione dei patrimoni immobiliari e referenze presso i principali player nazionali.
* **Ambiente di Lavoro Stimolante:** Inserimento in un team multidisciplinare e qualificato (dalla consulenza energetica alla progettazione e gestione immobiliare).
* **Flessibilità e Work\-Life Balance:** Orari e modalità di lavoro flessibili per garantire l'equilibrio tra vita privata e professionale, con possibilità di smart working.
* **Benessere Organizzativo e Sviluppo:** Attraverso il supporto di un partner specializzato in organizzazione aziendale, garantiamo percorsi di crescita personalizzati per valorizzare il potenziale di ciascuno, promuovendo il benessere lavorativo e il principio della «persona giusta nel ruolo giusto».
* **Crescita Professionale:** Formazione continua sul campo in un settore (quello della riqualificazione ed efficienza energetica) in fortissima espansione.
* **Strumenti Avanzati:** Utilizzo delle tecnologie più avanzate per la gestione dei patrimoni immobiliari, la progettazione e il riposizionamento degli asset immobiliari.

**Sede di lavoro:** Padova (con possibilità di brevi trasferte per sopralluoghi in loco).

**Inquadramento:** tipo di contratto commercio\-servizi con 14 mensilità. Full Time – indeterminato. Buoni pasto. Smart working. RAL fino a 35\.000,00 €/anno in base all’effettiva esperienza.

Retribuzione: Fino a €35\.000,00 all'anno

Benefit:

* Assistenza sanitaria integrativa
* Buoni pasto
* Cellulare aziendale
* Computer aziendale
* Lavoro da casa
* Orario flessibile
* Supporto allo sviluppo professionale

Esperienza:

* Architetto/Ingegnere/Geometra: 3 anni (Obbligatorio)

title: Addetto/a allo sviluppo contatti commerciali
description:
Tao Technologies è l'azienda italiana che produce Taopatch®, l'unico dispositivo wearable basato sulla nanotecnologia per il riequilibrio neuromuscolare, distribuito tramite una rete di oltre 4\.000 professionisti sanitari in tutta Italia e in altri paesi del mondo.

Sarai il primo contatto tra Tao Technologies e i potenziali clienti professionali (medici, fisioterapisti, odontoiatri).

**Il tuo compito è trasformare l'interesse del professionista in un appuntamento concreto con il team commerciale, nello specifico:**

* Contattare professionisti che hanno già espresso interesse e richiesto una consulenza (lead caldi, non chiamate a freddo random)
* Qualificare l'interesse e il fit del potenziale partner/cliente
* Fissare appuntamenti per il team commerciale
* Aggiornare il CRM con esito e note di ogni contatto

title: Commerciale Servizi HR (formazione e consulenza) - M/F/NB
description:
Chi siamo?
  
  

Randstad Enterprise è la divisione specializzata del Gruppo che, attraverso la società Randstad HR Solutions, si occupa di people strategy rivolta a organizzazioni e persone.
  
  

Per le aziende che devono affrontare cambiamenti e sfide complesse, disegnamo soluzioni che incidono su cultura e struttura organizzativa innestando fasi di consulenza con il team di advisory a servizi più verticali di talent acquisition, talent development e talent transition.
  
  

Randstad Enterprise non è solo una società di consulenza, ma un partner che accompagna le aziende e le guida verso le sfide del futuro. Per trasformare il cambiamento in opportunità.
  
  

**Commerciale Servizi HR (formazione e consulenza) \- M/F/NB:**  

Vuoi diventare un\* consulente strategico/a che aiuta le aziende a crescere attraverso la Formazione Finanziata e i servizi di People Strategy?
  
  

Unisciti al nostro team Sales lavorando sul territorio delle province di Padova, Venezia, Rovigo e aree limitrofe e diventa il punto di riferimento per lo sviluppo commerciale e la consulenza sui nostri servizi di formazione (finanziata e a mercato) e consulenza HR.
  
  

**Di che cosa ti occuperai:**  

Nel ruolo di Sales Consultant diventerai il motore della nostra crescita insieme al team che già opera sul territorio, con un ruolo centrale che unisce vendita strategica, consulenza e networking e ti occuperai di:
  
  

**Sviluppo e Gestione del Portfolio Clienti:** attività di sviluppo commerciale proattivo, gestione e fidelizzazione del portafoglio clienti assegnato sul territorio di competenza.
  
  

**Consulenza Specialistica HR:** fornitura di consulenza qualificata alle aziende in merito a percorsi di formazione finanziata, programmi di sviluppo a mercato e interventi di consulenza organizzativa.
  
  

**Elaborazione e Presentazione di Proposte:** pianificazione commerciale reattiva e proattiva, con conseguente elaborazione di proposte customizzate e presentazioni a clienti e stakeholder, in stretta collaborazione con i team interni di progettazione.
  
  

**Sinergie e Cross\-Selling:** promozione attiva di dinamiche di cross\-selling e sviluppo di un network interno alle società del Gruppo Randstad a livello territoriale.
  
  

**Sei la Persona Giusta Se:**  

hai maturato un'esperienza (anche breve) in ruoli di vendita servizi, preferibilmente nell'ambito delle Risorse Umane/People Strategy.
  
  

possiedi una forte attitudine commerciale e consulenziale e ami l'idea di costruire relazioni di fiducia duratura con le aziende del territorio;
  
  

**hai un interesse per i contenuti HR:** Formazione \& Sviluppo, Consulenza Organizzativa, Transizione di Carriera, e l'ottimizzazione della Formazione Finanziata.
  
  

sei in grado di lavorare in autonomia ma riconosci il valore del lavoro di squadra per raggiungere risultati ambiziosi.
  
  

sei disponibile a muoverti sul territorio delle province di Padova, Venezia, Rovigo ed aree limitrofe (Patente B e auto propria sono richiesti).
  
  

Cosa Ti Offriamo
  
  

Entrare nel nostro team significa scegliere un percorso di sviluppo accelerato e un ambiente che pone il benessere e la crescita individuale al centro:
  
  

inserimento con Contratto di Lavoro Subordinato (CCNL Terziario, 14 mensilità) a tempo determinato iniziale di 12 mesi.
  
  

**RAL:** 24\.000 \- 28\.000 €; Livello: 4° o 3°;
  
  

sistema bonus legato alle performance, ticket restaurant.
  
  

piano di sviluppo individuale strutturato e accesso continuo a percorsi di formazione specialistici per farti crescere come Consulente HR.
  
  

**flessibilità \& wellbeing:** modalità di lavoro ibrida che alterna presenza in filiale (una delle nostre sedi) e lavoro da remoto, con iniziative dedicate al work\-life balance e al benessere della persona.
  
  

**Sede di Lavoro:** Una delle nostre filiali sul territorio di riferimento.
  
  

**Orario:** Full\-Time.
  
  

Candidati ora per entrare in un team in cui potrai imparare, crescere e fare la differenza fin da subito!
  
  

Il presente annuncio è rivolto a persone di genere femminile (F), maschile (M) e non binario (NB) ai sensi della Legge n. 300/1970, del Decreto Legislativo n. 198/2006 e del Decreto Legislativo n. 96/2026 ed è aperta a qualsiasi persona nel rispetto della diversity e dell'inclusività. Ti preghiamo di leggere l'informativa sulla privacy Randstad (https://www.randstad.it/privacy/) ai sensi dell'art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 sulla protezione dei dati (GDPR).

title: Downstream Manager BU Western Europe - Sales Italy B&I
description:
**Chi siamo: Wavin, il business Building \& Infrastructure di Orbia**


E se il tuo lavoro potesse migliorare il modo in cui l’acqua si muove, il modo in cui le città si adattano alle sfide del futuro e il modo in cui gli edifici funzionano ogni giorno?


In Wavin, il business **Building \& Infrastructure di Orbia**, è proprio questo ciò che facciamo.


Ti accoglieremo in un ambiente stimolante e inclusivo, dove il nostro scopo prende vita ogni giorno. Qui ci assumiamo la responsabilità gli uni degli altri e della nostra azienda, affrontiamo con coraggio la sfida dell’innovazione e valorizziamo la diversità di prospettive, competenze e talenti.


Incoraggiamo le nostre persone a sviluppare il proprio potenziale e a diventare la migliore versione di sé stesse. Lavorando insieme come una squadra solida e affiatata, contribuiamo a crescere e a migliorare la qualità della vita in tutto il mondo.


Entrerai a far parte di un team internazionale e professionale e potrai beneficiare di un pacchetto retributivo e di benefit competitivo.

**Il tuo ruolo**


Il **Downstream Manager BU Western Europe \- Sales Italy B\&I** svolge un ruolo chiave nella supervisione e gestione complessiva delle attività commerciali downstream dell'organizzazione. È responsabile dell'implementazione della strategia commerciale all'interno della Business Unit, garantendo un forte orientamento al cliente e la gestione delle relazioni commerciali, nel rispetto delle politiche e delle procedure aziendali.


Attraverso la guida di un team di Area Manager e della forza vendita sul territorio, nonché la definizione e il monitoraggio degli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI), questo ruolo mira a ottimizzare l'efficienza operativa, ridurre i costi e mitigare i rischi legati alla strategia e agli obiettivi commerciali, contribuendo così alla solidità finanziaria e all'efficacia operativa dell'azienda.

**Principali responsabilità**

* Tradurre la strategia della Business Unit in una strategia locale e in un piano commerciale nazionale, definendo obiettivi e azioni.
* Garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di fatturato, margine lordo standardizzato (GSM) e sostenibilità del team commerciale.
* Gestire direttamente clienti strategici.
* Implementare la strategia di pricing, assicurando l'allineamento tra i diversi canali commerciali.
* Coordinare e supervisionare la transizione da Upstream a Downstream, garantendo la corretta chiusura dei progetti.
* Raccogliere e condividere esigenze, richieste e trend emergenti del segmento Downstream con le funzioni globali, contribuendo allo sviluppo dell'offerta aziendale.
* Guidare l'applicazione della metodologia SAMBA e supportare la crescita professionale dei membri del team commerciale attraverso attività di coaching.
* Assumere la responsabilità della leadership del team, occupandosi di selezione, sviluppo e fidelizzazione delle risorse ad alte prestazioni.

**Requisiti**


Cerchiamo una persona precisa, proattiva e orientata al risultato e al miglioramento continuo, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla qualità del lavoro svolto.

**Requisiti essenziali:**

* Conoscenza del sistema SAP.
* Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese, sia scritta che parlata.
* Esperienza di 3\-6 anni in ruoli commerciali presso aziende multinazionali oppure esperienza equivalente all'interno di funzioni commerciali correlate.
* Requisiti fisici compatibili con il ruolo, quali mobilità, capacità visive e altre eventuali idoneità previste dalla normativa locale.
* Solide competenze commerciali e forte orientamento al business.
* Eccellenti capacità negoziali.

**Cosa offriamo**


Entrare in Wavin significa far parte di un’organizzazione internazionale che mette al centro innovazione, sostenibilità e sviluppo delle persone.


Ti offriamo:

* Un ruolo interessante e stimolante.
* Opportunità di partecipare a progetti innovativi e sfidanti.
* Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e positivo.
* Concrete possibilità di crescita e sviluppo professionale.
* tutti gli strumenti di lavoro necessari
* auto aziendale
* carta di credito
* Bonus del 20% della RAL a raggiungimento dei target assegnati


Wavin, il business Building \& Infrastructure di Orbia, è un fornitore innovativo di soluzioni per il settore globale dell’edilizia e delle infrastrutture. Grazie a oltre 70 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti, contribuiamo a migliorare la qualità della vita in tutto il mondo garantendo un approvvigionamento idrico sicuro ed efficiente, sistemi di drenaggio, igiene e servizi sanitari adeguati, città resilienti ai cambiamenti climatici e migliori prestazioni degli edifici.


Wavin conta oltre 10\.000 dipendenti distribuiti in più di 40 siti produttivi a livello globale e serve clienti in oltre 80 Paesi attraverso una rete internazionale di vendita e distribuzione. I nostri principali marchi commerciali sono Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin e Plastigama Wavin.


Wavin, il business Building \& Infrastructure di Orbia, è impegnato a promuovere un processo di selezione inclusivo. Accogliamo con favore le candidature di tutte le persone qualificate, indipendentemente da genere, età, provenienza, orientamento sessuale, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica personale.

title: Product Compliance & Laboratory Intern
description:
### **Position**

The **Product Compliance \& Laboratory Intern** will join the Quality Excellence team and support activities related to product compliance, laboratory testing, and quality assurance processes. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in product testing, regulatory compliance, laboratory operations, and cross\-functional collaboration within a dynamic and international environment.


The successful candidate will work alongside experienced professionals, contributing to testing activities, documentation management, and continuous improvement initiatives while developing both technical and professional skills.


### **Job responsibilities**

### **Product Testing and Validation**

* Support the execution of product tests to verify compliance with regulatory and CE requirements.
* Assist in conducting product evaluations and collecting test data.
* Help review and organize test results and related documentation.
* Support the preparation of test reports according to internal standards.
* Learn and apply standardized laboratory testing procedures.

### **Laboratory Instrument Management**

* Support the monitoring of laboratory equipment status and maintenance schedules.
* Assist in coordinating calibration and maintenance activities with external suppliers.
* Help maintain laboratory records and documentation.
* Ensure laboratory areas and documentation are kept organized and up to date.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Quality, R\&D, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to support compliance\-related activities.
* Participate in cross\-functional meetings and contribute to data collection and reporting.
* Provide operational support for compliance and testing projects.

### **Compliance Support and Data Analysis**

* Assist in collecting and analyzing data related to product compliance and laboratory test results.
* Support the review of technical documentation and compliance records.
* Contribute to the identification and reporting of potential compliance issues under the guidance of senior team members.
* Support the preparation of presentations and reports for internal stakeholders.

### **Continuous Improvement**

* Support initiatives aimed at improving laboratory processes and testing procedures.
* Contribute ideas and recommendations based on data analysis and observations.
* Participate in quality and continuous improvement projects within the team.
### **Profile**

* Degree (completed or in progress) in Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Biology, or a related scientific field.
* Basic knowledge of laboratory practices and testing methodologies.
* Analytical mindset and problem\-solving attitude.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.  
* 
### **Additional information**

Thank you in advance for your interest in this opening. Thélios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender (including gender identity and expression), pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under applicable federal, state or local laws. At this time, only qualified candidates will be contacted.


Accordingly to internal internship regulations, for this position the month base salary €800,00\.
